entities.name: Halfdane
entities.description: A mentally unstable shapeshifter from Tolaria obsessed with his reflection, a killer in Ramses Overdark's service.

entities.name: Kei Takahashi
entities.description: Killed by Halfdane in an ambush.

entities.name: Barktooth Warbeard
entities.description: Marshal killed by Halfdane, who took his place.

entities.name: Ragnar
entities.description: Said to have been killed by Halfdane.

entities.name: Ramirez DePietro
entities.description: Said to have been killed by Halfdane, whose guise Halfdane also took.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: Group Halfdane met on his travels; it left Dominaria for Phyrexia after the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: Captured Halfdane and made him his minion, amplifying his powers.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: War during which Halfdane was sent to Kusho.

entities.name: Kusho
entities.description: Island whose manalines Halfdane poisoned with black mana crystals.

entities.name: Tor Wauki
entities.description: Sent on a bogus mission and wounded; later avenged Kei by killing Halfdane.

entities.name: Xira Arien
entities.description: Ambushed Kei and Tor alongside Halfdane.

entities.name: Ayesha Tanaka
entities.description: Tracked Halfdane and froze the water he stood in.

events.summary: Halfdane kills the people who named him because he did not want to be the 'half' of anything.
events.quote: Halfdane killed them because he did not want to be the "half" of anything.

events.summary: Ramses Overdark captures Halfdane and makes him his minion, amplifying his powers.
events.quote: Eventually 'Dane was captured by Ramses Overdark , who made the shapeshifter his minion and greatly amplified his powers.

events.summary: During the Madara-Edemi War Halfdane is sent to Kusho to poison its manalines with black mana crystals.
events.quote: Halfdane was sent to Kusho to poison its manalines with black mana crystals made by Overdark

events.summary: Halfdane kills Barktooth Warbeard and takes his place to infiltrate the kentsu.
events.quote: Halfdane killed Barktooth Warbeard and took his place to infiltrate the kentsu

events.summary: Posing as Warbeard then Ramirez DePietro, Halfdane lures and ambushes Tor and Kei with Xira Arien; Kei is killed and Tor wounded.
events.quote: In this incident, Kei was killed and Tor wounded

events.summary: Tor and Ayesha Tanaka cure the manalines and fight Halfdane; Ayesha freezes the water so his reflections mesmerize him and Tor kills him with black-mana magic.
events.quote: Then Tor cast a black-mana spell to kill him.
